finding.claim: Proxy /nodes/* admin endpoints (add, remove, terminate, terminate_all) are reachable without a token when api_keys is set, because the auth middleware skips any path starting with '/nodes'.
finding.source: Unauthenticated network client sending requests to /nodes/add, /nodes/terminate, /nodes/terminate_all on a proxy started with api_keys.
finding.sink: NodeManager.add / terminate_node / terminate_all_nodes; outbound GET {node_url}/terminate; registration of attacker node URLs that receive forwarded client headers (including Authorization) and request bodies via _prepare_headers.

trace.note: AuthenticationMiddleware added when api_keys is set
add() registers node directly when status.models is non-empty, no reachability check
_prepare_headers forwards all client headers including Authorization to node
request body posted to selected node URL
get_node_url selects node by model name (selection policy not fully verified)

finding.guards_checked: AuthenticationMiddleware present and uses secrets.compare_digest on SHA-256 hashes (sound); the defect is the skip-prefix check. validate_json_request only checks content type. api_server.py also skips '/nodes' but defines no /nodes routes there, so harmless. Not verified: the exact node-selection policy in get_node_url.

finding.claim: Server-side request forgery via DNS rebinding: the hostname is resolved and checked for global IPs in _is_safe_url, then resolved again by requests.get, so the connected address can be a private or loopback address.
finding.source: Attacker-supplied image_url / video_url / audio_url / time_series_url string in a /v1/chat/completions request.
finding.sink: requests.Session.get(parsed.url) at connection.py:83 (outbound HTTP from the server).

trace.note: user media URL passed to load_from_url
client.get re-resolves hostname (second lookup, not pinned to checked IP)

finding.guards_checked: Scheme restricted to http/https; is_global check on all resolved addresses; redirects disabled and each hop revalidated (lines 83-90); optional allowed_media_domains (default None, so no allowlist by default); fetch timeout. Gap: check and connect use separate DNS resolutions with no IP pinning.

finding.claim: file:// and raw filesystem paths in media URLs are loaded from the server's local disk. The allowed_media_domains allowlist does not apply to this branch, so the server can be made to read arbitrary readable files.
finding.source: Attacker-supplied image_url / video_url / audio_url / time_series_url string such as file:///path or a raw absolute or relative path in a /v1/chat/completions request.
finding.sink: media_io.load_file(Path) reading local files (image.py:31-35; time_series.py:31-38 for .npy/.csv).

trace.note: user media string passed to load_from_url with allowed_media_domains
branch taken when scheme=='file' or os.path.exists(url) or os.path.exists(url_spec.path)
Path built from netloc+path via url2pathname, no root confinement

finding.guards_checked: allowed_media_domains enforced only in _load_http_url (line 75), not for file URLs. No scheme or path-root restriction found in the media layer or serve/ processors. Exfiltration is limited: decoded content is not echoed back, so the main exposure is file existence/readability and decode-side effects; impact rated medium-low.
